annotations.title: US weather forecast and active alerts (NWS)

description: Weather forecast and active alerts for a US address or lat/lon point: NWS office, grid, forecast and county zones, time zone; 7-day periods (temperature, wind, precipitation chance, short and detailed forecast) or, with hourly=true, the next 24 hours adding humidity and dew point; active watches, warnings and advisories with event, severity, urgency, certainty, headline, timing and area. Sources: NOAA National Weather Service API, US Census Geocoder for addresses. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: One-line US street address (5 to 100 characters), geocoded with the Census Geocoder. Mutually exclusive with lat/lon.

hourly.description: true returns the next 24 hourly periods (with humidity and dew point) instead of the 7-day day/night periods. Default false.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, paired with lon; rounded to 4 decimals. Points outside NWS forecast coverage (US states and territories, land) return 404.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat; rounded to 4 decimals.
